content.jointProblem: Can a Bayesian/extreme-value spatial model link Pannonia's settlement-level farm policies and MeteoVoj daily 5-km grids to field-level hail intensity estimates, and then test whether those estimates explain the 18% claims excess and identify underpriced portfolio segments? The first experiment would validate the transferred model on held-out claim years and compare it against municipality-level hail loadings.

rationale.text: Struhár is open to joint projects and contract research on probabilistic risk and pricing models.

sources.quote: joint projects with companies generating high-frequency sensor or telematics data
contract research on probabilistic risk and pricing models

rationale.text: He has spatial extreme-value modelling experience with max-stable processes, which is relevant to testing field-level hail intensity surfaces and spatial dependence.

sources.quote: A spatial analysis using a max-stable process model reveals a correlation range of approximately 2.1 km

rationale.text: He has built credibility-weighted actuarial pricing models and measured claim-cost prediction gains, relevant to identifying mispriced portfolio segments.

sources.quote: The credibility-weighted premium estimator reduced the mean squared prediction error of claim costs by 14.2%

rationale.text: He leads probabilistic modelling and uncertainty quantification in a Pannonian precision-agriculture network across 28 farms, giving familiarity with Vojvodina farm settings and sparse environmental data.

sources.quote: Struhár leads the work package on probabilistic modelling and uncertainty quantification, contributing Gaussian process and Bayesian hierarchical methods tailored to irregular and energy-constrained sampling schedules
deploys sensor networks across 28 partner farms and two experimental stations

rationale.text: He has prior consulting experience with a regional property insurer on sensor-based premium adjustment and regulatory documentation.

sources.quote: provided statistical consulting to a regional property insurer on the design of a sensor-based premium adjustment scheme for commercial fire risk

constraints.text: Field-level matching must handle settlement-only policy addresses and daily 5-km weather grids, because hailstorms are narrow and fast-moving.

sources.quote: a large share of our farm addresses are stored only at the settlement level, not as coordinates
daily gridded weather data from MeteoVoj d.o.o. at a five-kilometre resolution
Vojvodina hailstorms are narrow and fast-moving

constraints.text: The method must be automated into the quarterly pricing pipeline, not left as manual QGIS analysis.

sources.quote: turning that into something that feeds the pricing model automatically is beyond what our team can do alone
Python-based batch scoring pipeline for quarterly rating factor refresh

constraints.text: Only three claim years for about 1,200 farm policies are available, so rare-hail validation will be limited.

sources.quote: three full claim years with geo-tagged loss data for about 1,200 farm policies

constraints.text: Model features and quarterly updates must satisfy Serbian/EU insurance law and be interpretable to regulators.

sources.quote: discusses regulatory constraints on feature selection under Serbian and EU insurance law

constraints.text: The company has no dedicated research unit; delivery depends on a small pricing team with operational duties.

sources.quote: The company has no dedicated research unit; applied development work is carried out by a four-person pricing team

constraints.text: A formal data-sharing agreement is required before policy or claim data can be used.

sources.quote: prefers collaborations where data-sharing agreements can be established formally; his department has a standard template for this

risks: The spatial extreme-value evidence comes from water-distribution pressure spikes, not hail; the 2.1 km correlation range may not transfer to hail swaths.
Settlement-level addresses and daily 5-km grids may be too coarse for narrow hailstorms, so geocoding and interpolation uncertainty could dominate the claimed field-level signal.
The researcher's availability for a joint project is unknown; his notes only state capacity for one further industrial PhD candidate from 2025–2026.
Pannonia has no dedicated research unit and its pricing/IT staff split time with operations, so model integration and iterative validation could stall.
Three claim years and about 1,200 farm policies may not support robust out-of-sample validation of rare hail events.
Regulatory interpretability and feature-selection constraints may limit the use of complex spatial or Bayesian models in pricing.
questions: Should this be a joint project or an industrial PhD, and what is the researcher's actual availability and start date?
Can Pannonia provide a geocoded subset of farm policies, and what geocoding precision can be achieved for the remaining settlement-level addresses?
Can MeteoVoj provide historical daily 5-km grids for all three claim years, plus any radar, hail-swath or higher-resolution data under a research licence?
Which pricing model, rating factors and integration points should the method connect to: the Python batch scoring pipeline, PostgreSQL warehouse, or Guidewire?
What regulatory documentation and interpretability tests are required before a new hail factor can enter pricing?
What anonymisation/security rules, data-sharing template and ownership terms will apply to derived hail intensity surfaces?
